duplicate_entry.title: Already configured: line {line}, {stop}
duplicate_entry.description:
**The line {line} at {stop} is set up twice.**

Home Assistant can only show one sensor for it, so the second entry has none.

Remove one of the two entries: **Settings > Devices & services > Warsaw Public Transport**.

legacy_key.title: Old API key: line {line}, {stop}
legacy_key.description:
**The line {line} at {stop} still uses a key of the City's old API.**

It works, but the City has published no date for its end. The new API with a token is the current service.

To switch:

1. Get a token at [dane.um.warszawa.pl/pl/key-api](https://dane.um.warszawa.pl/pl/key-api).
2. Open the integration and choose **Configure** on this entry.
3. Paste the token.

You can dismiss this notice.
